name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Mix in buffalo sauce and ranch dressing.
Fold in shredded chicken and half the cheddar.
Spread into a baking dish. Top with remaining cheddar and mozzarella.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
Serve hot with tortilla chips and celery sticks.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free cream cheese and vegan cheese.
substitutions.gluten_free: Serve with gluten-free chips or veggies.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve with celery and cucumber instead of chips.
